classification: pre-registered weight-neighborhood and moving-block stability audit for R452 value_quality; no new raw data and no promotion

grid.bootstrap: 5000 moving-block resamples of the daily 60-day neutral IC series
grid.simplex: all nonnegative weights on a 0.05 grid summing to 1.0

known_limits: Weight grids are correlated, not independent experiments.
The audit uses neutralized IC, not a portfolio return.
No new financial fields are introduced.
Current HS300 membership and current industry classification retain survivorship bias.
